name: East Potomac Golf Links
location: East Potomac Park, Washington, District of Columbia
architects: Walter Travis (Blue course) and Robert White (White and Red courses); opened in stages 1921-1925

dtm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar bare-earth DEM, 1 m, NAD83(HARN) / Maryland State Plane (EPSG:2804), metres; DC-wide file DC.TIF.2.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

chm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar normalized digital surface model (height above ground), 1 m, EPSG:2804, metres, water = -5; DC-wide file DC.TIF.1.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped with pipeline/clip_raster.py
chm.label: DC lidar normalized surface model

blossom.note: flowering cherries for the potomac theme: deciduous trees <= max_h m outside the golf boundary, within shore_m m of open water and max_from_boundary_m m of the boundary (the Ohio Drive / seawall ring of Yoshino and Kwanzan cherries); species is inferred from location, not measured

world.note: bbox of the four OSM course boundaries (Blue, White, Red, Practice Holes: 965 x 1929 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks: 1280 m east-west (~157 m each side, mostly river and channel), 2048 m north-south (45 m south, 74 m north) to stay within the 2,048 m limit (COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1)

layouts.name: East Potomac Blue Course
layouts.scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF 'EP-BLUE-Scorecard - INSIDE 3 Nov 2021' supplied by the developer 2026-10-19 (yardages, pars, stroke index). Ratings/slopes from GolfNow/TeeOff (course 8074), retrieved 2026-10-19, unverified: stymie.golf lists different values (Blue 70.0/112, White 68.2/107)

layouts.name: East Potomac White Course

tee_sets.name: Red
tee_sets.note: not built: most forward (Red) tee boxes are not in OSM or the lidar pads; 3+ holes fail the 8% check from the White boxes

layouts.scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF 'RedWhite-Scorecard' (playdcgolf.com) supplied by the developer 2026-10-19; nine-hole ratings/slopes printed on the card. The card's White total (2943) is a misprint: its nine holes add up to 2,493. Family tees (Blue, Gold) not built

layouts.name: East Potomac Red Course

tee_sets.name: Red
tee_sets.note: not built: most forward (Red) tee boxes are not in OSM or the lidar pads; 3+ holes fail the 8% check from the White boxes

layouts.scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF 'RedWhite-Scorecard' (playdcgolf.com) supplied by the developer 2026-10-19; par-3 course, no rating/slope on the card (0 = not rated)

attribution: Elevation and canopy: District of Columbia lidar 1 m DEM and normalized surface model, DC GIS / OCTO (CC BY 4.0)
Scorecards: East Potomac Golf Links (National Links Trust)
notes: Three courses on one island share one world: every layout is exported as its own course (courses/<layout id>/) whose terrain, surface, height and overview files live in courses/east_potomac/. Out of bounds = outside the union of the four OSM golf-course boundaries (Blue, White, Red, Practice Holes).
